messages.subject: Executive Leadership Profile | UAE/GCC, Government Relations, ESG & Strategy
messages.body:
Dear James,

I am reaching out directly following an earlier delivery failure to TLH Recruitment Middle East's general mailbox. Your current role leading TLH Recruitment's Middle East expansion, together with your long-standing UAE recruitment network, makes you the right person to review my profile for senior regional mandates.

I currently serve as Liaison Director, Social Responsibility Department at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group. My leadership remit spans government and regulatory relations, ESG and sustainability, external and corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, strategic partnerships, executive advisory and country-facing coordination in a complex, regulated mining environment.

My work requires direct engagement with ministries, regulators, public institutions, communities, industry bodies and senior corporate leadership. I coordinate high-scrutiny regulatory, stakeholder, reputation and operating matters across multiple functions, while supporting sustainability, social performance and major investment priorities. I also support governance and external positioning around AGM's approximately 46-50 MWp solar platform and more than 80 MWh of battery storage.

I am exploring senior leadership mandates across the UAE, Saudi Arabia and the wider GCC, including Country Director or Representative, Executive Director, Director or Head of Government Relations, Corporate Affairs, ESG and Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships, External Affairs, Stakeholder Engagement and Country Operations. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

I have attached my current GCC executive CV for your review. I would welcome consideration for mandates where senior stakeholder leadership, government interface, ESG, institutional coordination and country execution are central to business performance.

Kind regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
Liaison Director | ESG | Corporate Affairs | Government Relations
